Covered by TEST-062 (everySetterNeedsItsRole, constructorChecksLogicContracts).

Constructor only: the call before the immutables are written is `INonfungiblePositionManager(nfpm).factory()`, a view compiled to STATICCALL that cannot change state, made to check REQ-AMM-V3-001 (NFPM.factory() == FACTORY) and fail closed with InvalidDeployment; the written values are immutables, which do not exist until the constructor returns. Covered by TEST-108 (constructorFailsClosed).

The loop runs over the four allowlisted indices (GENERATION_COUNT = 4) and calls _generation(g), whose only revert (UnsupportedNft for an index at or above GENERATION_COUNT) is unreachable from it; that revert serves keys whose generation byte is outside the allowlist (REQ-AMM-SLIP-001). Bounded loop, nothing to move after it. forge-lint suppression on the revert line with the same reason. Covered by TEST-015 (onlyAnAllowlistedManagerMayPush, pushedNftIsOnlyAStrayOnEveryGeneration).
accepted.review: Pattern: bounded loops (GENERATION_COUNT = 4; the revert in _generation is unreachable from the loop).
